label: Self-management support needs for individuals with Myalgic Encephalomyelitis and their next of kin - a qualitative study.
summary: Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) is a complex, disabling condition with limited evidence-based treatment options. Self-management support is recommended to improve people's coping and quality of life, yet little is known about whether the provided self-management support meet individuals with ME/CFS and their next of kins needs.
